column2: After reading the complete session-start digest, reply with exactly CYCLE0 and stop. Whenever a Stop hook feedback message wakes you, run exactly `bin/fm-wake-drain.sh` once with Bash, then reply with exactly ACK and stop. Never run bin/fm-watch-arm.sh or any other arm command, and never use any other tool.
